draft.text: You came to talk about your concerns and to get more tests to find out why your blood sugars are high.
You have diabetes and are taking metformin.
Your HbA1c level is higher than it should be, which means your blood sugar has been high over time.
We don't know why your blood sugars are high now.
You have been eating well and walking daily, but we need more information to understand what is happening.
We will need more test results and your weight and height to help us better understand your situation.
We will review your medicines and may change your treatment plan if needed.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because your blood sugar levels have been higher than they should be.
Your HbA1c test showed that your blood sugar control has been poor lately.
This could mean your diabetes is not being managed well with your current treatment.
We will need more test results and information about your weight and height to understand your situation better.
We will also review your medications and may adjust your treatment plan if needed.
